name: Bokun
summary: Booking management for tours and activities, by Tripadvisor. Manage availability, channel sales and online bookings in one place — built for experience businesses.
best_for: tour, activity and experience operators who want booking management plus wide OTA distribution (Viator, GetYourGuide and more) from one dashboard
skip_if: you're a tiny operator taking a handful of direct bookings where the fees and setup outweigh the reach, or you want to stay off OTA rails entirely
honest_knock: Bokun is a Tripadvisor/Viator company, and that's both the draw and the lock-in. Distribution to Viator and 2,600+ resellers is excellent, but you're building your booking backbone inside one OTA's ecosystem, and the per-booking service fee on direct sales is a real cut on top of the subscription — although any paid plan lets you pass that fee to the guest instead of absorbing it. The zero-fee promise on Viator bookings has one exception the tier table does not show: Channel Manager customers pay 0.5-1.5% on Viator reservations. If most of your business is direct, weigh that fee; if you live on OTA distribution, the Viator advantage is hard to beat.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-20 on bokun.io/pricing, plan cards and the full comparison table) (2026) A free version (1 user) plus paid plans from $49/mo (Start, up to 5 users), $149 (Plus, up to 10) and $499 (Premium, unlimited). Service fee on applicable bookings varies by plan (1.5% Start, 1.25% Plus, 1% Premium), and any paid plan lets you pass that fee on to the guest. Crucially, zero Bokun booking fee on Viator and offline bookings — with one exception the tier table does not show: Channel Manager customers, who connect their own reservation system, are charged 0.5-1.5% on Viator reservations. 14-day free trial, no card, cancel anytime. UNCHANGED SINCE 2026-09-11 on every amount. THE FREE PLAN IS THINNER THAN ITS CARD SUGGESTS: in the comparison table on the same page, FREE carries exactly two ticks — manage availability, and import products directly from Viator. The 'Book now' button, access to the Marketplace of OTAs and resellers, Google Things to do, the website builder, the mobile app, gift cards, payment links, pass-the-fee and point of sale are all marked absent on FREE and present from START. TWO CONTRADICTIONS ON THE PAGE ITSELF, read 2026-09-20: (1) the FREE card lists 'Zero fees on Viator' under Includes, while the comparison table marks the row '0% booking fees on Viator bookings' blank on FREE and ticked on START, PLUS and PREMIUM; the page never resolves which is right. (2) 'Allocation Manager' appears twice in the comparison table with different marks — once ticked from PLUS, once ticked from START — and the PLUS card lists it as a PLUS addition. ALLOWANCES THE TIER CARDS DO NOT SHOW: free Viator product submission checks, which the page calls compulsory for anyone listed on Viator, run 12 a year on START (a value the page puts at $348/yr), 24 on PLUS ($696/yr) and 48 on PREMIUM ($1,392/yr), with none on FREE — $29 a check by their own arithmetic. Automated reservation management emails are capped at 500 a month on START and unlimited on PLUS and PREMIUM. Subvendors: 5 on PLUS, 15 on PREMIUM. Webhooks, Zapier, custom booking areas for agents, extra go-live support and the annual account review start at PLUS; priority support is PREMIUM only.
